name: contratos-imobiliarios
description: Controle de protocolo de entrega e devolucao de contratos de credito imobiliario

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run db:setup
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix backend run prisma:migrate -- --name init && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
